title: tpkg blksum v1
description: The per-block-group digest sidecar for lazy range-fetch mounting (spec 39 §3): one sha256 per 4 MiB group of the IMAGE bytes, plus the whole-image sha256 the seal pass re-verifies. Generated in-process by `tebako publish` (or the factory release leg) in the same invocation that stages the release bytes; anchored by the release shard/registry row's additive `image.blksum` field. Unknown keys are tolerated at every level for forward compatibility; schema_version pins the version.

group_size.description: The locked fetch unit: 4 MiB of image bytes (spec 39 §11.3). The final group is short.

size_bytes.description: The whole image's byte length — group count derives as ceil(size_bytes / group_size) and MUST equal groups.length.

sha256.description: The whole-image sha256 — identical to the image's `.sha256` sidecar value; the seal pass's mandatory second anchor.

groups.description: One sha256 per group, in index order: group i covers image bytes [i*group_size, min((i+1)*group_size, size_bytes)). A range GET's bytes verify against groups[i] BEFORE entering the block cache.
